content: BR beauty-salon deposit and cancellation norms (Belasis, Trinks, Fenvix, Graces blogs): deposit typically 10-50 percent of service price (commonly 20 percent simple, 50 percent custom or complex); standard cancellation window is 24h before with no loss of deposit; late cancel under 12h can incur around 30 percent fee, true no-show forfeits deposit fully or triggers a 50 percent charge; deposit (arras) is legally grounded in Brazilian Civil Code if applied transparently. Reported impact: 60-80 percent drop in no-shows after adopting deposits.
